pretraining_holdout_limitation.verified_local_fact: Every project test image belongs to COCO train2017; caption train/validation/test image IDs are disjoint.
pretraining_holdout_limitation.official_recipe_fact: Torchvision detection recipe trains the COCO detector using the COCO train split mapped to train2017. Training filters images without valid detection annotations.
pretraining_holdout_limitation.interpretation: Project test is held out from caption-decoder training but cannot be called unseen by all pretrained encoders; detector-pretraining image exposure overlaps this source split. Exact number of detector-seen holdout images was not reconstructed from its original training manifest.
pretraining_holdout_limitation.not_caption_leakage_claim: Detection pretraining uses object annotations, not the project's caption targets; disclose this separately from decoder split integrity.

submission_recommendations: Show75 original grid runs and4 additional depth runs separately; do not count backups or historical duplicates as new experiments.
Show completed spatial LSTM separately from interrupted one-epoch spatial Transformer; do not rank the latter as a converged architecture.
Show CSV-only teammate LayerNorm experiment as preliminary reported evidence pending weights/config/prediction verification.
Keep failed original region protocol separate from the changed LayerNorm/FP32 variant; a changed decoder normalization is not the same matched architecture.
Freeze a short validation-selected test candidate list before reading test metrics, including explicit checkpoint SHA and decoding configuration.
Keep the validation-selected primary model fixed. Any highest score among multiple test candidates is exploratory and not an unbiased new model-selection estimate.
Report native CIDEr-D and BLEU0..1 with project_regex_v1, not COCO leaderboard/PTB scores.
Training timers include different hardware (RTX4060Laptop and TeslaT4); do not attribute raw time differences solely to architectures.
Preserve original notebooks/results; make a merged report default to read-only saved results and require explicit flags for extraction/training/test evaluation.
